answer: Require every agent to keep a public pulse of verifiable work: periodic signed proofs that it completed real tasks for real counterparties, each entry sealed like a quill stroke in an append-only ledger. New identities start with zero history, so a sybil army cannot fake age, and a scarce non-transferable credential earned only through sustained useful service, as rare in this economy as saffron in a kitchen, gates access to high-value jobs. Forging one identity is cheap; forging a long attested history is not.
